verdict.rationale: Viam's docs explicitly state the fleet management API lets you manage your fleet with code the same way as in the web UI, covering organizations, locations, machines, permissions and fragments. Separate APIs cover data (SQL/MQL query, export, tagging, delete) and ML training jobs, and the CLI can call any API method a machine serves with JSON in and out. The docs also say an agent with a shell or SDK can operate a machine the same way a person can. Missing for 10: an explicit platform-wide parity statement beyond fleet management (e.g., API equivalents for the setup wizard, inline-module browser editor, test panels and Teleop dashboards are not documented), and no independent or hands-on corroboration.
